newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices down sans festival buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices down sans festival buying.

text.p: Indian sugar prices fell on Tuesday in the absence of heavy festival buying, dealers said.

"Festival buying in the open market was low on account of increased supplies at the public distribution system while stockists remained active sellers fearing that the government may pump in more stocks," one trader said.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 slid by 10 rupees to 1,290/1,325 rupees while M-30 fell by 3/7 rupees to 1,320/1,365 rupees. Sugar mill delivery moved down to 1,190/1,210 rupees from 1,210/1,230 rupees.
